name: Media shelf
summary: Two swipeable rows for a streaming home: Continue watching, with drawn stills, a progress bar and the time left, and Because you watched, with drawn posters and New season tags.
use: on the home screen of a video, music or course app, for picking up where people left off
a11y: Each row is a labelled list that scrolls inside itself (swipe, shift-scroll or the arrow buttons, which turn off at each end); every title is one button whose name says the episode and time left.
